description: This Java source file defines the class ProductSearchSession, which manages product search options and operations within a web application's session context. It provides methods for handling search constraints, sort orders, and retrieval of search results, as well as session-based storage and retrieval of search parameters. The class supports complex search parameter processing, saving and restoring search states, and generating search parameter strings for user interface and URL encoding.

classes.name: ProductSearchSession
classes.description: Utility class for managing product search options and executing product searches within an HTTP session context, supporting constraints, sorting, and persistence.

classes.name: ProductSearchOptions
classes.description: Inner class representing search options and constraints, with methods for managing search parameters, sorting, and view state.

methods.name: getProductSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the current ProductSearchOptions object from session or creates a new one.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Saves the current search options into history if they have changed.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Returns the list of previous search options stored in session.

methods.name: clearSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Clears the search options history.

methods.name: setCurrentSearchFromHistory
methods.description: Sets the current search options based on a previous history entry, by index, with optional removal of old entry.

methods.name: clearSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Removes all stored search options history from session.

methods.name: setCurrentSearchFromHistory
methods.description: Endpoint method to set current search based on session history index, invoked via request parameters.

methods.name: checkDoKeywordOverride
methods.description: Checks for keyword overrides based on product store configurations and redirects if a match is found.

methods.name: searchDo
methods.description: Performs the product search based on current session options and constraints, returning a list of matching product IDs.

methods.name: searchClear
methods.description: Clears the current search constraints and options.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of human-readable search constraints for display.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current sort order.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for product search results.

methods.name: searchAddFeatureIdConstraints
methods.description: Adds constraints based on provided product feature IDs.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a search constraint to the current options.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a constraint at a specified index.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes HTTP request parameters to update current search constraints and options accordingly.

methods.name: getProductSearchResult
methods.description: Executes the search based on current session options and parameters, returning a map of results including product IDs, indices, and search info.

methods.name: makeSearchParametersString
methods.description: Serializes current search options into a URL query string format for display or bookmarking.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs the product search based on current session options and constraints, returning a list of matching product IDs.
